integrity: The all-modulus statement follows by an explicit two-adic Smith invariant-factor induction. The supplied code exhaustively verifies initial moduli only; finite enumeration is not presented as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the classical two-term Pell companion map on residue pairs modulo powers of two is classified.
The standard Pell-seed period is already known; the contribution is the all-seed cycle length and multiplicity classification.
An unindexed theorem or a sufficiently specialized general theorem could imply the counts and remains a literature risk.
title: Exact Pell-state cycle spectrum modulo powers of two
